blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines is hopeful that the emergency oil sharing framework it is pushing with neighboring countries will be ratified at the end of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit here. Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) spokesperson for Asean affairs Dominic Imperial said on Friday that the Philippines was the first country in the region to ratify the Asean Petroleum Security Agreement (Apsa), followed by at least four other member states. The government hopes Asean leaders will encourage their counterparts to speed up the ratification process, Imperial said during a press conference at the International Media […]...
